competition.note: Gamma_min > 0 : Omega_fold < 1 at the crossover, i.e. the fold volume NEVER beats the action at block level. 'Competition' is only in the derivative, not in which term wins.

conserved_by_is_identity.claim: (2pi)^{-m/2} det(K^T N^-1 K)^{-1/2} kappa^{m/2} and Schur det ratio = prod(1-sigma^2)
conserved_by_is_identity.tautology_risk: The Schur ratio identity is a linear-algebra theorem (true for any N,K), not a physical constraint. It constrains nothing about the physics; it only certifies the code computed the same object two ways.
